report:
Right paratubal cyst, excision

Received in formalin is a thin-walled paratubal cyst measuring 3 cm. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Cyst wall.

Sections show a fibrous cyst wall lined by a single layer of ciliated tubal-type epithelium. The features are consistent with paratubal cyst. There is no evidence of malignancy.

FALLOPIAN TUBE, right paratubal cyst, excision - PARATUBAL CYST
